title: Waited for Difficulty while Agent Judge blocked the screen
symptom: Platform returns 'Blocked at the agentic judge. Not run: difficulty screen (cheap single-arm rollout).' Operator looks for Difficulty logs or treats missing Difficulty as infra failure.
root_cause_class: Misread Aug 4 2026 eval order: Agent Judge runs before Difficulty; Difficulty intentionally skipped until Judge passes.
recovery: Fix Quality Check / Agent Judge citations first (blocking: test_coverage + test_faithfulness). Re-upload until Judge passes. Only then interpret Difficulty (4 trials/model, worse model ≤50% pass rate). See P-010.
automation_opportunity: Revision prompts and blockers should classify Judge-blocked vs Difficulty failure before asking for difficulty logs.
notes: Official Sentinel Ultra platform update 2026-08-04. Quality expectations unchanged; order + trial count only.
